style: Classic hand-drawn Japanese 2D cel animation from the late 1980s and 1990s: thin, clean, even-weight dark-brown outlines; flat cel colours with exactly ONE darker shadow tone per colour (hard-edged shadow shapes, light from upper left); no gradients, no painterly texture, no 3D shading, no glow. Natural, gentle proportions: the girl is about 7 years old and about 5 heads tall — not chibi, not big-eyed. Simple warm face: small dark eyes with one white highlight, tiny nose line, small mouth, soft pink cheeks. The same girl in every image: short black bob haircut with a straight fringe, orange-red hooded raincoat (#E0692E) reaching mid-thigh with dark-orange shadow, navy trousers, yellow rain boots.

assets.prompt: Character model sheet of the girl on a plain white background: three full-body views side by side at the same scale — front view, three-quarter view facing right, and side profile facing right — standing relaxed, hood down. No text, no labels.

The same girl, hood down, crouching on her heels in side profile facing RIGHT, arms hugging her knees, face half hidden against her knees, crying: eyes squeezed shut, tears on the cheek, shoulders raised. Full body.
Exactly the same crouching crying pose and framing as the second reference, but mid-sob: shoulders a little lower, head tilted slightly down, mouth trembling. Full body, side profile facing RIGHT.

The same girl still crouching on her heels in side profile facing RIGHT, arms around her knees, lifting her head to look up and ahead with wide surprised teary eyes, a tear drop on her cheek, mouth slightly open. Full body.

The same girl crouching on her heels in side profile facing RIGHT, leaning forward and reaching her right arm straight out in front of her at shoulder height, palm open as if touching something, curious hopeful face, eyes open. Full body.

Same crouching pose as the reference, reaching forward, her hand slightly lifted and turned as if gently wiping dust off something, small hopeful smile starting, eyebrows raised. Full body, side profile facing RIGHT.

The same girl crouching in side profile facing RIGHT with her right hand resting forward at shoulder height on something, a big gentle happy smile, eyes closed in happy upward arcs, pink blushing cheeks, the hood fallen down. Full body.
